verdict.rationale: The AMD Instinct MI325X is a datacenter GPU accelerator. It runs the customer's own workloads on the customer's own hardware or cloud instances (ROCm, partitioning, Kubernetes tooling), and it is not a service that collects user data. A training-data opt-out is therefore a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows AMD ingesting customer data through the hardware or its software stack, so the axis does not apply.
